== Amico's age ==

Just figured I'd chime in and mention that due to the White Tower's tradition of not accepting women over the age of 18 as apprentices it's entirely possible she lied about her age to be accepted as a novice. It's mentioned several times throughout the series that it's common for women to do this. [[User:Whitecroc|Whitecroc]] 16:41, April 27, 2011 (UTC)
:This, and the info on the page, isn't really isn't correct anymore. In early printings of {{tsr}}, it does say that Amico is only four years older than Egwene and Elayne. In later printings it is corrected to say that she is fifteen years older. ----[[User:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#0080FF;"> '''Willie'''</span>]] - [[User Talk:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#990099;">'''''HtS'''''</span>]] 18:08, April 27, 2011 (UTC)

== Shouldn't we change this article? ==

It is quite clearly stated in the later printings of The Dragon Reborn that Amico Nagoyin is fifteen years older than Elayne and Egwene, not four. I haven't changed the article as I notice the admin pointed out earlier that it was incorrect and it still hasn't been changed, but it seems like a pretty straightforward course of action to me. I am more than willing to do this myself, but I just thought I'd find out if there was any valid reason why the section about her age is still there when it is so obviously obsolete.
